'''Joshua Harris''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Sacramento Enduro]] on 29 September 2001 with Walkers, according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3004">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-30-enduro-iii-9-29-01d3004/ enduro-iii-9-29-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 30 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-30-enduro-iii-9-29-01d3004/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
